question: How many titles has Roger Federer won in the NetRank data?

gold.cypher: MATCH (p:Player {name: 'Roger Federer'})-[:WON]->(m:Match {round: 'F'}) RETURN count(m) AS titles

question: What is Andy Murray's win-loss record in tour-level matches?

gold.cypher: MATCH (p:Player {name: 'Andy Murray'}) RETURN COUNT { (p)-[:WON]->(m:Match) WHERE NOT m.walkover } AS wins, COUNT { (p)-[:LOST]->(m:Match) WHERE NOT m.walkover } AS losses

question: Who won the 2019 Wimbledon final, and what was the score?

gold.cypher: MATCH (w:Player)-[:WON]->(m:Match {round: 'F'})-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019}) RETURN w.name AS winner, m.score AS score

question: What is the head-to-head record between Novak Djokovic and Rafael Nadal?

gold.cypher: MATCH (a:Player {name: 'Novak Djokovic'}), (b:Player {name: 'Rafael Nadal'}) RETURN COUNT { (a)-[:WON]->(m:Match)<-[:LOST]-(b) WHERE NOT m.walkover } AS djokovicWins, COUNT { (b)-[:WON]->(m:Match)<-[:LOST]-(a) WHERE NOT m.walkover } AS nadalWins

question: How many times did Rafael Nadal beat Roger Federer on clay?

gold.cypher: MATCH (:Player {name: 'Rafael Nadal'})-[:WON]->(m:Match {surface: 'Clay'})<-[:LOST]-(:Player {name: 'Roger Federer'}) WHERE NOT m.walkover RETURN count(m) AS clayWins

question: What is the shortest chain of wins leading from Johan Kriek to Roger Federer, and how many steps does it have?

gold.cypher: MATCH (s:Player {name: 'Johan Kriek'}) MATCH (t:Player {name: 'Roger Federer'}) MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (s)-[:BEAT]->{1,6}(t) RETURN length(p) AS hops

question: Which opponent beat Roger Federer the most times, and how many times?

gold.cypher: MATCH (o:Player)-[b:BEAT]->(:Player {name: 'Roger Federer'}) RETURN o.name AS nemesis, b.wins AS wins ORDER BY b.wins DESC, o.name LIMIT 1

question: Who beat Rafael Nadal most often, and what is that player's all-time prestige rank?

gold.cypher: MATCH (o:Player)-[b:BEAT]->(:Player {name: 'Rafael Nadal'}) RETURN o.name AS nemesis, o.prestigeRank AS rank ORDER BY b.wins DESC, o.name LIMIT 1
